verdict.rationale: Replication and high availability are a fair axis for a database like LanceDB, but the evidence pack never documents node or zone replication, failover, or a consistency model. The storage docs only say LanceDB can run on NVMe, EBS, EFS, and S3-compatible object stores. Any durability those back ends offer belongs to the host platform, not to LanceDB, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can replicate data across nodes or zones for high availability with a documented consistency model
